data.description:
### 1. Technical Environment

* **code_version:** 42819289dc548d97c53db5e8230e2bb8a6780684
* **context:** merge-to-main.sh PR-mode remediate phase, merge.strategy=pr

### 2. Incident Overview

* **Scenario Type:** User-Flagged Behavior

#### Expected Behavior

Per merge-to-main.sh PR-mode: the LLM review step (CI llm-review-runner) must run after PR creation. When the LLM helper command is unavailable, the merge should fail or emit a blocking warning — not silently proceed and queue auto-merge.

#### Actual Behavior

merge-to-main.sh emitted the following warning and skipped the LLM review step entirely, then continued to queue auto-merge on PR #67:

  WARNING: _LLM_DISPATCH_CMD not set; no LLM helper available (deleted in S3) — LLM step skipped

Auto-merge was queued for PR #67 without LLM review having run. User caught this and requested the auto-merge be disabled before merge landed.

Root of issue: `_LLM_DISPATCH_CMD` was unset in the environment during the merge-to-main invocation. The S3 note in the warning suggests `llm-api-call.sh` was deleted as part of a prior refactor (the CI llm-review orchestrator migration), and this path was not updated.

### 3. Action History

1. `/dso:sprint 1cec-29dc` executed full epic implementation
2. `merge-to-main.sh` invoked at session end (merge.strategy=pr)
3. Branch pushed, PR #67 created, auto-merge queued
4. WARNING emitted: `_LLM_DISPATCH_CMD not set; no LLM helper available (deleted in S3) — LLM step skipped`
5. User flagged the skipped review; auto-merge disabled via `gh pr merge --disable-auto 67`

### 6. Logs

```
Pre-push format + lint check.............................................Passed
To https://github.com/navapbc/digital-service-orchestra.git
   b374154c21..42819289dc  worktree-20260506-183119 -> worktree-20260506-183119
INFO: Created PR #67: https://github.com/navapbc/digital-service-orchestra/pull/67
INFO: Auto-merge queued for PR #67.
WARNING: _LLM_DISPATCH_CMD not set; no LLM helper available (deleted in S3) — LLM step skipped
```
